title: The Nine Centuries of Calling
intro: Picture standing alone against a tide of mockery for longer than empires rise and fall, calling night and day while ears are covered and garments are pulled tight. Ahead lies a vessel built on dry land and waters unlike any seen before. Can you sense the patience behind this marathon of invitation?
clues: I invited my people night and day, in secret and openly, to worship Allah alone.
My people thrust fingers into ears and wrapped garments around themselves to turn away from me.
I remained among my people for nine hundred and fifty years calling them to guidance.
I built a vessel under Allah's eyes and revelation while my people mocked me on dry land.
I was commanded to carry aboard pairs of every kind and the believers when the command came and the oven overflowed.
I watched the waves rise like mountains as the flood drowned those who rejected, while Allah saved those in the Ark.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Dhul-Kifl
Prophet Al-Yasa (Elisha)
Prophet Nuh (Noah)
Prophet Lut (Lot)
Prophet Muhammad

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Defended my mother by speaking in infancy
Interpreted the ruler's dream while in prison
Called my people night and day for 950 years
Was taken up alive and raised to a high station
Was swallowed by a great fish in the sea
trial.answer: Called my people night and day for 950 years

location.label: Key Element
options: The golden calf of the wilderness
The fire made cool and safe
The palace with a floor of glass
The Ark (Al-Fulk)
The staff that became a serpent

outcome.label: Outcome
options: My people were destroyed by a freezing wind for seven nights
The rejecters drowned in the Great Flood and believers were saved
My people were destroyed by a mighty blast on one morning
My people were turned into apes for transgression
My people were swallowed by the earth for arrogance
outcome.answer: The rejecters drowned in the Great Flood and believers were saved

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verse: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day. (71:5)
